instruction.text: Form the correct sentence in indirect speech. Use all the given words.

atoms.a: My friend says, “My brother plays the guitar.”
atoms.b: My friend says that her brother plays the guitar.
Lena said that she felt sick.

instruction.text: Insert the correct pronoun or time expression.

atoms.b: Sarah mentions that ((++she I they)) loves Italian food.

atoms.a: He complained, “I don't understand this exercise.”
atoms.b: He complained ((++he I we)) didn't understand that exercise.

atoms.a: The teacher warned, “The homework today is important.”
atoms.b: Last year, the teacher warned that homework ((++that_day today yesterday)) was important.

atoms.a: Tom said, “We are watching a documentary right now.”
atoms.b: Tom said that ((++they we he)) were watching a documentary that moment.

atoms.a: Roberta said, “I will eat the pie tomorrow.”
atoms.b: Last week, Roberta said she would eat the pie ((++the_next_day tomorrow the_day_before)).

atoms.a: My father stressed, “You were supposed to do the laundry yesterday.”
atoms.b: Last month, my father stressed that I had been supposed to do the laundry ((++the_day_before yesterday the_day_after)).

instruction.text: Insert the verb in the correct form of indirect speech. Mind the tense of the introductory sentence.

hint.text:

Wenn der Begleitsatz im Präsens steht, wird die Zeitform in der wiedergegebenen Aussage nicht verändert. Steht der Begleitsatz in der Vergangenheit, muss die Zeitform ebenfalls zurückverschoben werden.

atoms.b: He states that his parents ((live)) in Canada.

atoms.a: She said, “I drink tea in the morning.”
atoms.b: She said that she ((drank)) tea that morning.

atoms.a: They claim, “We feel comfortable about the exam.”
atoms.b: They claim that they ((feel)) comfortable about the exam.
